title: Japan national CPI (November 2026) — the print that fixes 11 of 12 months of the 2026 yearly average
source: EST: stat.go.jp/english/data/cpi/1582.html ('Consumer Price Index — Schedule of Release', page's own 'Last Update : 23 January 2026'), re-fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 13,839 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its single 17-row HTML table by this session. Against the header 'Japan: Survey month | Date of release || Ku-area of Tokyo (preliminary): Survey month | Date of release || Remarks', the row parses exactly as ['November', 'December 18', 'December', 'December 25', '2026 yearly average of Ku-area of Tokyo'] — i.e. the November-2026 national CPI releases 2026-12-18. Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: for US statistical agencies and no slot for Japan's Statistics Bureau, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the schedule page has not been refreshed since 2026-01-23. Release time is not read off this page and is not asserted here.
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-2027-01-22 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and tracked for two reasons, both of which make it the more informative half of a pair whose louder half lands five weeks later. FIRST: it fixes the 2026 yearly average. That figure — a headline of the 2027-01-22 release — is the simple mean of twelve monthly index levels, and eleven of them are public once this print lands. Computed on the Statistics Bureau's own 2025-base national series (e-Stat statInfId=000040491314, parsed locally), a December year-on-year surprise of +/-0.5pp, +/-1.0pp or +/-2.0pp moves the 2026 annual rate by only +/-0.042pp, +/-0.084pp or +/-0.168pp, and the Bureau publishes the annual rate to one decimal. So the 2026 yearly average is effectively determined on THIS date, not on its own release date. SECOND: it shares its date with the Bank of Japan's December MPM decision (boj-decision-2026-12-18, estimate) — which is the ordinary case, not a special one. Cross-parsing boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ against this schedule, all six BoJ decisions concluding on a Friday share their date with a Statistics Bureau CPI release and none of the four concluding on another weekday does; every release date in the Bureau's table is a Tuesday or a Friday. Also expected to be the LAST national release carrying a 2020-base companion: the Bureau's 2025-base revision page states verbatim that 'the 2020-base CPI will also be calculated and released until December 2026', which on the plain calendar reading makes this the final parallel publication — a reading this lane flags as settleable free on the day rather than settled. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty and no house playbook is keyed to Japanese CPI. Related to FT-japan-cpi-2027-01-22-2 (the 2026 annual average band) and FT-japan-cpi-2027-01-22-3 (the Friday collision rule), both registered 2026-09-05.
